Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#45818e][size=3][b][color=#45818e][center]- - - What's new: - - -[/center] [/color][/b][/size][/color]
[/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]New reskins for fruit trees!! :D Mod author and artist [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/65673271]nottomention[/url] contacted me and made these absolutely gorgeous reskins for this series! Masculine/Manly trees >:D In case you do not know, they've also made [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8631]Obelisk Reskins[/url] and gorgeous [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8646]Magic Trees[/url]!! I am so grateful they submitted these skins for this mod ;7;

CP Version is up on their page! :D Replaces All fruit trees in game!

[u][color=#6aa84f]Smaller updates:[/color][/u]
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]Changed the config set up. Now, instead of toggling every single item "on" and THEN choosing your preferred reskin, now everything is neat(er) in simple drop-down menus :D Every reskin can be set to "off" if so desired.[/size]
[/list][size=2]
Edit: Slight change in sprite appearance by nottomention! :D [/size][size=2]
[/size][b][color=#45818e][size=3][center][color=#45818e]- - - Look forward to: - - -[/color][/center][/size][/color][/b]
[size=2]The rest of the sprite reskins for Forage dryads! Stormchild974 and eleseaHonu are working on their versions, [s]and I am working on editing the original ecchi versions to match their shrunken counterparts[/s] EDIT: I have been struggling with editing these trees so instead, I am working on repackaging the original trees and using those instead.[/size]

[u][color=#6aa84f][size=2]Known Issues/Glitches:[/size][/color][/u]
[size=2]A few, unfortunately. For one, there is NO INDICATOR that these dryads are finished producing, other than them suddenly not doing the machine bounce animation. This is an issue with Bigger Craftables, which "draws over" the original craftable to make room for bigger sprites. This does NOT mean that your product has "disappeared" rather. Interact with the tapper to get the product once the dryads stop moving. :)

B, there will not be a way- for now- to make the sprites seasonal or configurable using content patcher. I spent weeks trying to figure it out and talked to several other modders only to find out that Bigger Craftables loads directly to the game rather than through content patcher, so it can't be content patched like other mods that do.

III, a glitch I cam across on one of my test saves is that one of the craftable machines will register as a forageable item and not be interacted with other than to "harvest" it. This glitch will be noticeable if you have auto harvest mods or high enough foraging skills that allow you to gain multiples of foraged produce. I only noticed it in the one save, however (I have three test saves, each with different mods) and that tells me it's an issue I cannot fix on my end. I do not know what to do when this occurs but I can only hope that it was an isolated incident for me. My best advice is to test out the machines, with all of your preferred mods, in a throwaway save file before going in with your actual save to make sure they work :)

Another issue is I noticed ONCE is if you cheat and spawn the dryad craftables into the game, you will never get the mail giving you the recipe and, thus, never be able to unlock the recipe yourself. If you want to unlock the recipes quick, just cheat the unlock requirements rather than spawn the machines :)
[/size]
[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#45818e][size=3][center][b][color=#45818e]- - - Overview:﻿ - - -[/color][/b][/center][/size][/color][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Hello! This is my first mod ever... and of course, it's on a lewd topic. Wasn't expecting this to be my introduction to modding but, here we are. I won't ramble too long, you already know what this mod is and hopefully, it is up to par with what was expected!

I've really wanted this mod in my game since I first saw it a few months ago but with all the retexture and foliage mods I own, I was woe to replace my entire aesthetic with lewd, hermaphroditic trees. Fast-forward to now, and I've finally gotten an understanding of how modding (for SDV) works, at least when it comes to content packs. So, with permission from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5991663]Alreito[/url], the author who brought us the 1.5 updated CP version (with ahegao! what a legend), I have converted his mod into Json Assets. For those who are new to modding for SDV or unaware, JA mods implement new items into a game without overriding or messing with vanilla items (or textures). You can have as many JA mods as you like (or however many your PC can handle) so you can mess with textures for base game as much as you want!
[/size]
[center][color=#45818e][size=3][b][/b][/size][/color][/center][center][color=#45818e][color=#45818e][size=3][b]- - - Features﻿: - - -[/b][/size][/color]
[/color][/center]
[/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Purchasable fruit dryads with their own lewd fruits and artisan goods, and lewd saplings.

Configurable reskins for every fruit tree and fruit to mix and match styles.

Forage Dryads as craftable "machines". Recipes are sent in the mail after reaching unlock requirements. For an in-depth look, click the spoiler below!
[spoiler]Mahogany has the following input/output:
Mahogany Seed[1]--> Hardwood; Chance of Rain totem, Island Totem, Radioactive and Iridium Ores, Artifact Trove, Wood, and Stone
Sap[5]--> Tree Fertiliser; Chance of other fertilisers with a higher chance of receiving Deluxe Quality Fertiliser, Deluxe Soil Retainer Fertiliser, and Hyper Speed-Gro
Mixed Seeds[3]--> Winter Seeds; Chance of pineapple seeds, taro tubers, and ginger
Driftwood[5]--> Hardwood; Chance of Wood and Stone

Maple has the following input/output:
Maple Seed[1]--> Maple Syrup; Chance of Warp Totems (Island and Rain not included), Wood, and Stone
Sap[5]--> Tree Fertiliser; Chance of other fertilisers with a higher chance of receiving Quality Fertilisers
Mixed Seeds[3]--> Summer Seeds; Chance of summer crop seeds, including 2nd year, Oasis, and travelling merchant crops
Hazelnut[2] + Sugar[4]--> Maple Syrup

Oak has the following input/output:
Acorn[1]--> Oak Resin; Chance of Ores (not including radioactive), Wood, and Stone
Sap[5]--> Tree Fertiliser; Chance of other fertilisers with a higher chance of receiving Soil Retainer Fertilisers
Mixed Seeds[3]--> Spring Seeds; Chance of spring crop seeds, including 2nd year, Oasis, and travelling merchant crops
Spice Berry[2] + Vinegar[4]--> Oak Resin

Pine has the following input/output:
Pinecone[1]--> Pine Tar; Chance of Geodes, Wood, and Stone
Sap[5]--> Tree Fertiliser; Chance of other fertilisers with a higher chance of receiving Speed-Gro Fertilisers
Mixed Seeds[3]--> Fall Seeds; Chance of fall crop seeds, including 2nd year, Oasis, and travelling merchant crops
Wild Horseradish [2]+ Oil[4]--> Pine Tar

Mushroom has the following input/output:
Common Mushroom [5]--> All mushrooms, including common mushroom and island magma cap
Mushroom Tree Seed[1]--> Red and purple mushroom and magma cap
Any trash item not including Joja Cola [1]--> Clay; Chance of Coal, Grass Starter, and Fiber
[/spoiler]
[/size][center][color=#45818e][size=3][b]- - - Install: - - -[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[size=2]Make sure you have required mods! This mod requires SMAPI, Json Assets, and whatever required mods Json Assets may need to work!
Edit 01 May 2021: Added Requirements are Producer Framework Mod, Bigger Craftables, and Mail Framework Mod. Optional requirements are Better Artisan Good Icons (for wine and jelly nsfw icons) and Content Patcher (for Reskins). Download those and their mod requirements as well :)
[/size][list=1]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Download and unzip file by preferred method[/size][/font]
[*][size=2]Extract files to StardewValley/Mods folder OR extract to another folder/desktop and drag only the file that says [JA] Ahegao Fruit Trees in StardewValley/Mods folder[/size]
[*][size=2]Load game through SMAPI and play![/size]
[/list][size=2]
[/size][size=3][b][center][color=#45818e]- - - Uninstall: - - -[/color][/center][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=2]Make sure all items from this mod are cleared from your inventory and chests[/size]
[*][size=2]Destroy all planted trees on your farm or in greenhouses.[/size]
[*][size=2]Once you are absolutely sure every trace of the items are gone within the game, remove this mod from your folder.[/size]
[/list][size=2]It is important you follow these uninstall steps!! Otherwise, you will end up with a null object that will crash your game upon interaction with it! And null objects cannot be deleted!
[/size]
